metadata.title: Micron Stock Jumps After Big Earnings Beat. The Chip Sector Is Rising, Too.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Micron Stock Surges After Chip Supply Shortages Send Earnings Into the Stratosphere
Micron Technology stock surged ahead of the open Thursday after the memory chip maker reported strong third-quarter earnings.
